caption:
Feel torn up by the roots? He plants what was scattered — never to be pulled up again. (Amos 9:15 devotional)

The book that began as a curse ends planted, and never uprooted again. Even if you feel uprooted, He has ground for you.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Where do I feel uprooted — displaced, unbelonging, torn from what I loved?
